scenario_meta.description: A public museum exhibits debts that nations, guilds, and families have not incurred yet. Curators stabilize possible obligations, actuaries price alternate histories, thieves swap liability provenance, and visitors can make an exhibit become real. Build exactly six connected, functionally distinct galleries and twelve socially entangled agents. Make probability and debt ownership alter access, prices, relationships, room states, and future event hooks. Include one or two monumental world-specific semantic exhibits per room. Use black basalt, frosted glass, oxidized silver, signal red, pale mint illumination, and white ceramic tally forms without writing in a coherent top-down pixel-art canon. Avoid generic museums, generic sci-fi terminals, Beijing references, signs, captions, readable letters, logos, and text baked into art.
scenario_meta.simulation_objective: Simulate a counterfactual economy where causal consequences are traded, priced, and realized through social entanglement.

inventory_generation.policy: Generate actionable inventory from specialist-selected item ids only. Property and knowledge assets come from specialist templates and runtime augmentation.

task_ledger.self_outcome: {self} checks the task ledger and reprioritizes obligations.
task_ledger.target_outcome: {self} opens the task ledger for {target}, making the backlog visible.

meeting_notice.self_outcome: {self} rereads the meeting notice and prepares a response.
meeting_notice.target_outcome: {self} passes the meeting notice to {target}, drawing them into the issue.

tea_coupon.self_outcome: {self} redeems a tea coupon and regains focus.
tea_coupon.target_outcome: {self} shares a tea coupon with {target}, easing the discussion.

image_generation.prompt_policy: Grounded social-systems illustration with readable rooms, paperwork, tools, and no visible text or watermark.
image_generation.default_prompt_template: {domain_label}. Create one polished still image of {image_subject} for {actor_name} and {target_name}. Emphasize lived-in civic interiors, notices, ledgers, and social coordination pressure. No visible text, no watermark.
